On a bounded connected smooth domain, let two pairs of smooth real Lamé moduli satisfy $\mu>0$ and $3\lambda+2\mu>0$ on the closure. If their full displacement-to-traction maps agree, then both Lamé moduli agree throughout the domain. The selected statement is uniqueness; it does not supply a reconstruction algorithm.” Quoted, not judged: AMVO has not compared this Lean statement with the family's claims or with the manuscripts.
